family: 口径争议：616 只无因子 vs 78 / 355 / 236
status_meaning: 该口径可复现且已定论（status 枚举在此表示'争议可否定论'，不是'策略族可做'）
settlement: 616 可复现但语义不成立（应为'无复权因子事件行'）；78/355/236 三数均可复现；663 无法复现
conclusion: 定论：616 可精确复现，但语义被误读。616 = 面板 5,813 只证券中在 adj_factor（复权因子事件表）里没有任何一行的证券数（5,813 − 5,197 = 616，按前缀 00:225 / 30:92 / 60:186 / 68:69 / 92:44）。adj_factor 是按除权事件写的表，这 616 只在 789,432 行行情里 close 与 raw_close 完全相等（0 行差异），仅说明本地价格一致，不能证明真实世界没有除权事件；不能将其直接等同于'研究因子库缺失'；'无因子'应写作'无复权因子事件行'。另外三个数字同样可精确复现且口径互不相同：78 = 元数据 5,536 中有、日线面板 5,813 中完全没有日线的证券（1990 年代上市、2018 年前已退市/更名的老代码，15 只名称含'退'）；355 = 日线面板中有、元数据中没有的证券（全部为北交所 92x）；236 = 日线面板中四张财务表都没有任何记录的证券（样例均为退市/*ST）。三者之和 669 ≠ 616，说明它们不是同一口径下的互补分解，不能互相印证。数值巧合：2026-11-06 当日科创板（68x）恰好也是 616 只，与'无复权因子行'的 616 无关。663 无法复现：236 / 313 / 266 / 628 / 802 / 1,079 均不等于 663。

facts.name: 缺表矩阵：面板 5,813 只 / 元数据 5,536 只 对各数据集的缺口
facts.sql: select 'instruments' as table_name, (select count(*) from ins) as table_symbols, (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from ins)) as panel_missing, (select count(*) from ins where symbol not in (select symbol from panel_agg)) as instruments_missing union all select 'adj_factor', (select count(*) from adj_syms), (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from adj_syms)), (select count(*) from ins where symbol not in (select symbol from adj_syms)) union all select 'balance_sheet', (select count(*) from fin_bs), (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_bs)), (select count(*) from ins where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_bs)) union all select 'income', (select count(*) from fin_income), (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_income)), (select count(*) from ins where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_income)) union all select 'cash_flow', (select count(*) from fin_cf), (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_cf)), (select count(*) from ins where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_cf)) union all select 'metrics', (select count(*) from fin_metrics), (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_metrics)), (select count(*) from ins where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_metrics)) union all select 'any_financials', (select count(*) from fin_any), (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_any)), (select count(*) from ins where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_any))
facts.note: panel_missing = 该表没有、但面板有日线的证券数；instruments_missing = 该表没有、但元数据里有的证券数

facts.name: 两个宇宙的交集
facts.sql: select (select count(*) from panel_agg) as panel_symbols, (select count(*) from ins) as instruments_symbols, (select count(*) from ins where symbol in (select symbol from panel_agg)) as intersection

facts.name: 616 只无复权因子行的证券（按代码前缀）
facts.sql: select substr(symbol,1,2) as prefix, count(*) as n from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from adj_syms) group by 1 order by 1

facts.name: 616 只的首根 K 线年份分布
facts.sql: select case when first_date >= date '2023-01-01' then '2023+' when first_date >= date '2020-01-01' then '2020-2022' when first_date >= date '2018-01-08' then '2018-2019' else 'pre-2018' end as bucket, count(*) as n from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from adj_syms) group by 1 order by 2 desc

facts.name: 616 只的 复权价 vs 原始价 一致性
facts.sql: select count(*) as rows_scanned, count(*) filter (where close is not null and raw_close is not null and abs(close - raw_close) > 1e-6) as rows_with_adjusted_diff, count(distinct symbol) filter (where abs(close - raw_close) > 1e-6) as symbols_with_adjusted_diff from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily_enriched/**/*.parquet') where symbol not in (select symbol from adj_syms)
facts.note: 0 差异仅证明本地复权价与原始价一致；无因子事件行不能证明真实世界无除权，也不能排除供应商漏记

facts.name: 78 只无日线的证券（按代码前缀）
facts.sql: select substr(i.symbol,1,2) as prefix, count(*) as n from ins i where i.symbol not in (select symbol from panel_agg) group by 1 order by 1

facts.name: 78 只无日线的证券：退市名称 / 缺失上市日
facts.sql: select count(*) as n, count(*) filter (where coalesce(i.name,'') like '%退%') as delisted_name, count(*) filter (where i.listing_date is null) as null_listing_date, min(i.listing_date) as earliest_listing, max(i.listing_date) as latest_listing from ins i where i.symbol not in (select symbol from panel_agg)

facts.name: 78 只无日线的样例
facts.sql: select i.symbol, i.name, i.listing_date from ins i where i.symbol not in (select symbol from panel_agg) order by i.symbol limit 10
facts.note: 样例为 1990 年代上市、2018 年前已退市/更名的老代码

facts.name: 236 只无任何财务报表的证券（按代码前缀）
facts.sql: select substr(symbol,1,2) as prefix, count(*) as n from panel_agg where symbol not in (select symbol from fin_any) group by 1 order by 1

facts.name: 236 只的样例（面板内且有元数据的交集部分）
facts.sql: select i.symbol, i.name, i.listing_date from ins i where i.symbol not in (select symbol from fin_any) order by i.symbol limit 10
facts.note: 样例均为退市/*ST 老代码；财务报表库只覆盖当前存续标的

facts.name: 三表齐全的证券数
facts.sql: select (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol in (select symbol from fin_bs) and symbol in (select symbol from fin_income) and symbol in (select symbol from fin_cf)) as panel_all_three, (select count(*) from ins where symbol in (select symbol from fin_bs) and symbol in (select symbol from fin_income) and symbol in (select symbol from fin_cf)) as instruments_all_three

facts.name: 主板口径下的财务缺口（用于对账 663）
facts.sql: select (select count(*) from panel_agg where substr(symbol,1,2) in ('60','00') and (symbol not in (select symbol from fin_bs) or symbol not in (select symbol from fin_income) or symbol not in (select symbol from fin_cf))) as panel_mainboard_any_missing, (select count(*) from ins where substr(symbol,1,2) in ('60','00') and (symbol not in (select symbol from fin_bs) or symbol not in (select symbol from fin_income) or symbol not in (select symbol from fin_cf))) as instruments_mainboard_any_missing, (select count(*) from ins where substr(symbol,1,2) in ('60','00') and symbol not in (select symbol from fin_income)) as instruments_mainboard_no_income

facts.name: 2026-11-06 当日各板块证券数
facts.sql: select substr(symbol,1,2) as prefix, count(*) as n from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily/date=2026-11-06/part.parquet') group by 1 order by 1
facts.note: 68 开头正好 616 只 —— 与'无复权因子行'的 616 数值相同但完全无关

facts.name: 对账 663 的候选口径
facts.note: 由 sql_log 中面板/元数据/三表齐全三条 SQL 组合而成；没有任何候选等于 663，'663 只无财务'在本数据上无法复现（差异 ≥ 35）
